screenshots.alt: Headline “Your Family’s Second Brain” with a 5+ Million families badge and an Editors’ Choice laurel, above Home: a SweetSpot bedtime near 7:30 PM and cards for Sleep, Nursing, Bottle, Diaper and Pumping
Headline “Get Predictability Back in Your Day” above Oscar’s week calendar, March 1 to 7: cyan sleep blocks, orange marks and “Oscar slept 11h 42m”, with a Best Apps for Parents laurel
Headline “Take the Guesswork Out of Naptime” above a lock screen: a smiling baby at 10:50 and a SweetSpot alert, near 11:00am, coming up in 10 minutes
Headline “Watch Your Baby’s Sleep Improve, Week by Week” above Sleep Trends for 1 year: naps 3h 7m, nights 11h 9m, a 14h 16m daily average and 7 bars
Headline “Your Parenting Questions Answered” above 2 Berry AI chats: “How do I get Emma to sleep past 5AM?” and a teal “What’s on your mind?” screen, marked for paid subscribers
Headline “Made For All Feeding Types” above a nursing timer with orange Left and Right buttons, and Add Solids: banana, sweet potato and carrot to try next
Headline “Get Tips Shaped by Your Baby’s Routine” above an Insights tip in 4 steps: hold your baby close, walk 5 minutes, sit 8 minutes, transfer to the sleep area
Headline “Know Exactly When the Last Diaper Was” above Add nappy: Poo picked at 9:41 AM, size Little, 6 color dots and a green Save button
Huckleberry pricing on the Yearly tab: Premium, best value, $9.99 a month billed yearly with $14.99 struck
Huckleberry Plus card: $5.74 a month billed yearly with $11.99 struck, and 3 highlights
Huckleberry Free card: $0 forever free, a Get the app button and 3 highlights
Huckleberry pricing on the Monthly tab: Premium at $14.99 a month, still marked best value

ourRead: Yearly opens first and crosses out the monthly price: $14.99 sits above $9.99 a month, billed yearly. Premium’s year reads as 33% off.
Plus is the decoy on Monthly: $11.99, $3 under Premium’s $14.99. On Yearly it turns into the bargain, $5.74 a month, 52% off against Premium’s 33%.
Free keeps every log and caregiver sync at $0. Plus sells SweetSpot nap predictions for $5.74 a month; Premium adds Berry AI chat and sleep plans for $9.99.

improvements.title: Set button labels in dark navy
improvements.detail: White “Get started” reads at 2.4:1 on #02B6D1, and 1.8:1 on the lighter #36D2E9 of “Get the App”. Keep the cyan and set the labels in #2B3648, the navy of the SweetSpot alert: 5.0:1 and 6.7:1.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

improvements.title: Keep one filled button per screen
improvements.detail: The first screen shows 2 filled cyan pills, “Get the App” and “Get started”, and the Free card fills a third. Make “Get the App” a text link and give Free the outline of “Learn more”.
improvements.rule: Emphasize the CTA. One filled primary button, everything else secondary or text.

improvements.title: Put SweetSpot and $5.74 in the headline
improvements.detail: The headline reads “Support that fits your family”. Name the feature the store description calls most-loved, with the entry price: “SweetSpot nap predictions from $5.74 a month”.
improvements.rule: Make headlines specific. "Track 3 habits in 10 seconds a day" beats "Transform your life".

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Huckleberry's style. Top to bottom: a centered headline and a Yearly and Monthly pill toggle. Below: stacked white plan cards with 16 px corners, priciest first, free last, each with a full-width pill button. Type: Avenir or Nunito Sans, heavy headlines and prices, regular body, in slate navy #44526C. Colors: ice white #F3FFFF (60) for the page, berry cyan #31BCD3 (30) for buttons with navy labels, leaf lime #CDCC04 (10) for the top plan's outline. Open on Yearly: cross out the monthly price above the per-month price. Show a trial only if you offer one. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
